# Broken Links and Empty Content — Findings and Fixes

**Date:** 27 October 2026  
**Scope:** all 52 published HTML pages, dynamic links generated by `app.js`, `config.js`, `quran.js` and inline page scripts  
**Status:** Internal-link crawl clean; three real runtime link defects fixed.

---

## 1. Method

Three complementary checks were run:

1. **Static anchor scan** — every `<a href>` in all 52 HTML files, resolving relative targets against the file's directory.
2. **Fragment scan** — 451 links containing `#fragment`, checking that the target file contains the matching `id` or `name`.
3. **Rendered-DOM crawl** — all 52 pages loaded in a real browser at `http://localhost:3400`, collecting every resolved `<a>` (including links created by JavaScript), then requesting every unique same-origin destination.

The rendered crawl is the authoritative check because several IDs and links are created at runtime.

## 2. Real defects found and fixed

### 2.1 Search results from article pages pointed into `/articles/articles/…`

**Where:** `public/js/app.js`, search modal result template.  
**Symptom:** From `/articles/islamic-finance-and-riba.html`, searching `zakat` produced:

- `http://localhost:3400/articles/articles/zakat-educational-calculation-guide.html` → 404
- `http://localhost:3400/articles/zakat-calculator.html` → 404
- Quick pills: `http://localhost:3400/articles/quran.html?surah=36` → 404

**Cause:** `search.js` stores site-root-relative URLs (`articles/foo.html`, `quran.html`) by design. The modal inserted them directly into `href`, so the browser resolved them relative to the current `/articles/` directory.

**Fix:** added `UniversalSearch.resolveUrl(url, basePath)` and `App.resolveUrl(url)`; the modal now prefixes the deployment root (`/`, `/NoorDeen/` or the `file://` bundle directory). Quick-pill Quran links and the language-modal Quran link use the same resolver. `quran.js` offline fallback links use it too.

**Verified:** six `zakat` results and six quick pills from an article page all returned HTTP 200.

### 2.2 Cookie banner privacy link 404 on every article page

**Where:** `public/js/config.js`, `initCookieConsent()`.  
**Symptom:** On all 25 article pages, the consent banner's “Privacy Policy” link resolved to `/articles/privacy.html` (404).  
**Cause:** hard-coded `href="privacy.html"` in a runtime template.  
**Fix:** added `PortalConfig.getBasePath()` and changed the link to `${this.getBasePath()}privacy.html`.  
**Verified:** from an article page the link now resolves to `/privacy.html` → HTTP 200.

### 2.3 Daily Companion linked to a non-existent Dua anchor

**Where:** `public/index.html`, Sayyid al-Istighfar row.  
**Symptom:** `duas.html#dua-sayyid-istighfar` did not match any ID.  
**Actual ID:** `dua-sayyidul-istighfar`.  
**Fix:** corrected the href.  
**Verified:** the target element exists and carries the expected title.

## 3. False positives (not defects)

| Finding | Why it is not broken |
|---|---|
| `bookmarks.html` → `quran.html?surah=${b.surahNumber}#ayah-${b.ayahNumber}` | JavaScript template literal; the rendered bookmark links resolve correctly. |
| `kalimas.html` → `#kalima-1…6` | IDs are generated at runtime as `id="kalima-${k.id}"`; all six exist in the rendered DOM. |
| `dr-israr-ahmed.html` → `' + escapeHtml(v.sourceUrl) + '` | Template literal inside the card renderer; each rendered card has a real Tanzeem source URL. |
| Live crawl 404 for the same template string | Crawler followed the literal JavaScript source, not the rendered link. |

## 4. Final rendered crawl

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Pages loaded | 52 |
| Pages with load errors | 0 |
| Unique same-origin link destinations | 123 |
| Broken destinations (non-200) | **0** |
| Empty `href` / `href="#"` / `javascript:` links | **0** |
| Anchors with no text | **0** |

This includes 26 root pages and 26 pages under `articles/`.

## 5. Fragment-link audit

- 451 fragment links checked.
- 8 flagged by the static scan.
- 7 were the runtime-generated false positives above.
- 1 was a real mismatch (`#dua-sayyid-istighfar`) and is fixed.

## 7. Tests added

Suite 41 in `test/run-tests.js`:

- resolver unit tests for GitHub Pages, root, fragments, absolute URLs, bare anchors and `file://` bases;
- asserts search results, quick pills, language modal and Quran fallback use the resolver;
- asserts the cookie banner uses `getBasePath()`;
- asserts no document-relative search-result href remains.

Full suite after these fixes: **1,519 executed / 1,519 passed / 0 failed**.

A post-change static + HTTP recheck (after the final asset-version bump and rebuild) requested 81 unique internal destinations across 52 pages: one non-200, the literal JS template `' + escapeHtml(v.sourceUrl) + '`, and seven fragment flags, all of which are the documented runtime false positives above. No new broken link was introduced.

## 8. Remaining limitations

- External bot-blocked sites are not machine-verifiable from this environment.
- No Android device is available, so links inside the APK were verified by asset inspection, not by tapping through the installed app.
- The crawl covers published pages; it does not prove that every future content addition will stay link-clean. The static and rendered scans should be re-run after each content batch.
